title: Key Flare
description: Creates a new Minecraft controls screen with a color-coded visual keyboard to show if keys have conflicting functions.
body:
If you have ever loaded up a massive modpack only to open the controls menu and get blinded by a sea of red, conflicting keybinds, you know how much of a headache it is. Trying to figure out which keys are actually free on your keyboard shouldn't feel like a puzzle game.

This mod completely overhauls Minecraft's clunky, endless scrolling controls screen and replaces it with a nice, interactive dual-pane dashboard. On the left side of your screen, you get a beautiful visual layout of your keyboard and mouse. On the right, you get a cleaned-up, modern dark-themed version of the classic keybind list that actually matches the vibe.

### Key Features

* **Color-Coding:** You can see your entire setup at a glance. Completely free keys glow a clean green, keys with a single function have a soft yellow glow, and conflicting keys pulse a bright neon red so you can spot trouble instantly.
* **Hover Tooltips:** Hovering your mouse over any key on the visual layout pops up a native tooltip showing you every single action currently bound to it.
* **Easy Key Management:** Left-clicking any key opens a quick management popup where you can see its assigned functions and clip them off individually with a little 'X' button. Need a total reset? Just right-click any key on the board to instantly wipe all of its bindings clean.
